# OpenState

Local project state and structural code tools for coding agents. $129 once per developer for every 0.x release, or $10 a month. All sales are final. The engine stays on the machine.

## Sales

- [index.html](index.html): the short version. What it does, four measured figures, how an edit works, the price.
- [pricing.html](pricing.html): $129 once for every 0.x release ($10 a month also available), what is included, Stripe checkout.
- [license.html](license.html): how Stripe and Keygen issue the key. The engine does not check the key at runtime.
- [terms.html](terms.html), [refund.html](refund.html), [privacy.html](privacy.html): the sale.

## Technical

- [technical.html](technical.html): architecture, what is recorded, comparisons, who it is not for, known weaknesses.
- [structural-tools.html](structural-tools.html): the 22 structural tools, guarantees, languages, and where a small edit costs more.
- [evidence.html](evidence.html): the ten measurements from the maintainer's own projects, August to October 2026. Not a controlled study.
- Method write-up: https://github.com/Michael-A-Kuykendall/openstate/blob/main/docs/evidence.md
- Tool reference: https://github.com/Michael-A-Kuykendall/openstate/blob/main/docs/STRUCTURAL-TOOLS.md
- Repository: https://github.com/Michael-A-Kuykendall/openstate

## Not claimed

No customer count. No fewer repeated failures. No hosted team service. The license is on the honor system.
